I didn't do 3D-92 on this branch. Rule 3 in AGENTS.md says one WP per branch, per PR and per session, and not to mix WPs. I asked you how to handle that in a dialog, but you weren't available. So I took the option that keeps the rule: 3D-92 stays `ready` in BACKLOG, and I wrote its handoff for a new session into `.agent/checkpoints/3D-91.md`. If you want it on this branch anyway, tell me and I'll record the exception in DECISIONS.md and add it.

**3D-91 is done but not closed out:**
- I added `ringArea` and `ringIsClockwise` to `packages/geo-model3d/src/ring.js`, with tests in `packages/geo-model3d/test/ring.test.js`.
- Both acceptance lines pass: the unit square has area 1 and is counter-clockwise, and its reverse has area 1 and is clockwise.
- The full unit suite, golden tests and the type, architecture and backlog checks all pass.
- I updated the checkpoint, then committed and pushed as `4bf08c5` on `wp/3d-91-ring-utils`.

**`npm run check` still fails.** `check:docs` rejects the BACKLOG rows 3D-91 and 3D-92 as "new final id on a WP branch". It fails the same way with my changes removed, because those rows were already on the branch when the session started. The coordinating session needs to fix it, not this WP. I wrote it in the checkpoint.

The 3D-91 row is still `in-progress`. Setting it to `review` needs the finish step (cost ledger and docs updates); say if you want me to run it.
